items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He wanted me to take some drum solos, which I did.

ctx.x: What kinds of things did Wilbur Sweatman ask you to do as far as playing drums? Were there any special
He wanted me to take some drum solos, which I did. The drum solo would run around about six or seven minutes, very short, you know. I didn't have too much time.
I see. Well, how about Eubie, personality-wise, at that time? Was he a very busy man? Was he (?) with these shows?
